description: This script manages firmware image download via TFTP or HTTP, verifies checksums, prepares storage partitions, extracts image components, updates active/inactive banks for firmware upgrade, and reboots the device.

methods.name: tftpDownload
methods.description: Downloads checksum and image files via TFTP, verifies MD5 checksum.

methods.name: httpDownload
methods.description: Downloads checksum and image files via HTTP, verifies MD5 checksum.
